segments.he: מַהוּ דְּתֵימָא כְּדַאֲמַר לֵיהּ רַב פָּפָּא לְאַבָּיֵי, קָא מַשְׁמַע לַן כִּדְשַׁנִּי לֵיהּ.
segments.en: The Gemara elaborates: «Lest you say, as Rav Pappa said to Abaye,» that in that case too, the Levite should be exempt from the requirement to separate teruma gedola from this produce, the tanna of the mishna «teaches us, as» Abaye «responded» to Rav Pappa, that there is a difference between a case when the grain was on the stalks and when it was collected in a pile. Therefore, one may not eat this produce before separating teruma gedola from it.
